plain_proposition: Adult capacities should be mapped by function and context rather than rated globally: a person may access Nurturer in calm states, Protector at work, and no adult function during shame or attachment panic.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Context specificity / state-dependent access are established roots.
notes: Extends article's three functions and daily-life transfer into a diagnostic matrix.

plain_proposition: When an inner-adult promise changes, explicitly retire/renegotiate the old promise instead of silently moving the goalposts.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Promise repair/renegotiation is familiar; exact versioning transfer not established.
notes: Could prevent apparent inconsistency from undermining trust.

plain_proposition: Ask the child or protector what it predicts the adult will actually do, then create a small observable test and compare prediction with outcome.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Expectancy violation and behavioral experiments are established.

plain_proposition: Ask a protector what specific evidence would justify relaxing by five percent rather than asking it to trust in the abstract.
common_sense_or_named_theory: IFS permission/protector work and behavioral experiments are familiar.
notes: Possible compact exercise after 'what do you fear would happen?'.

plain_proposition: Previously internalized adult functions may become temporarily inaccessible under severe stress; re-borrowing a function can be maintenance rather than proof internalization never occurred.
notes: Must not weaken owner's requirement that internalization is the goal.

plain_proposition: For irreversible decisions arising in altered states, require a second sober/regulatory confirmation unless immediate safety requires action.
common_sense_or_named_theory: State-dependent judgment safeguards are familiar; article already separates altered-state material from historical fact.

plain_proposition: Track experiential depth, integration, adult-function access, and ordinary outcomes as separate axes rather than using any one as a proxy for the others.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Multidimensional outcome/process measurement is standard; owner already corrected category confusion.
notes: Could operationalize the owner's depth/integration distinction.

plain_proposition: When reparenting stalls, localize the failure: wrong adult function, function absent, transfer failure, prerequisite/regulation failure, unrealistic commitment, helper dependency, or broader protocol problem.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Case formulation/fault isolation is familiar; workflow already owns the broader failure differential.
notes: Could turn owner correction into a reader-facing troubleshooting tree.

plain_proposition: Do not make distress the admission ticket to inner-adult attention; build ordinary positive child-adult contact through play, curiosity, celebration, and companionship as well as responding to pain.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Positive/child-directed attention and attachment secure-base work are established.
notes: Article says pl/ork and values play but gives little explicit non-crisis relationship practice.

plain_proposition: Proactive positive contact may reduce the chance that escalating distress becomes the only reliable channel for obtaining internal attention, without ever withdrawing care during distress.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Noncontingent attention/reinforcement is established in behavior analysis; transfer to inner-child practice not established here.
notes: Must avoid implying distress is manipulative or should be ignored.

plain_proposition: A parentified reader should practice receiving care without immediate repayment, caretaking, or emotional management of the helper.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Compulsive caregiving / suppressed care-seeking is established attachment prior art.
notes: Specific corrective exercise for pseudo-adult presentation.

plain_proposition: After a personal failure, Nurturer should usually make contact before Guide analyzes what to change, otherwise guidance can reproduce the inherited critic.
notes: Could pair with non-withdrawable Nurturer and repair-after-breach.

plain_proposition: Guide demands should be calibrated just beyond current capacity; overwhelming demands are not evidence of better leadership.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Scaffolding / zone of proximal development / graded challenge are standard.

plain_proposition: The child/protector may update trust asymmetrically after breaches, so one conspicuous failure can matter more than several routine successes; promises should therefore minimize avoidable high-salience breaches.
notes: Could explain why small reliable vows matter, but article already emphasizes track record.

plain_proposition: After a successful adult-child interaction, deliberately encode a cue that can later retrieve the experience under stress.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Retrieval cues and positive imagery are established learning mechanisms; article already uses physical reminders.

plain_proposition: Different-aged child-states may need different forms of adult response; the same explanation, choice burden, or boundary can be appropriate for an adolescent state and misattuned for a very young one.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Developmentally appropriate parenting is standard; article already distinguishes child/adolescent/younger-adult ages.

plain_proposition: Track process variables—self-attack, kept promises, boundaries, help-seeking, child trust—alongside outcomes so lack of change can be localized rather than treated as one undifferentiated treatment failure.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Process monitoring and mediation are standard; workflow already owns failure differential.
notes: Could strengthen outcome-measurement section if article gains one.

plain_proposition: Inner-child contact should continue during ordinary and good periods, not only during repair work, so the relationship becomes a life relationship rather than a crisis service.
common_sense_or_named_theory: Positive parenting/relationship maintenance are familiar roots.
notes: Strong article fit with pl/ork and healed-child qualities.
